# PR #3683: Patch: a minion's keyword loops move only while its face holds a motion slot (#3607)

Closes #3607

## What changed and why

Issue #3607, option (a): a board minion's looping keyword treatments now run (`data-kw-motion="on"`) only while its face holds one of the six shared motion slots, and otherwise show their still frame. Previously every board minion with keywords looped `infinite` regardless of the `COSMETIC_FOIL_ANIMATED_MAX` budget, ignoring off-screen pauses and the shed ladder.

- [MinionFace.tsx](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3607/apps/web/src/cards/MinionFace.tsx): split the single `useArtMotion` want into `artWanted` (exactly today's expression) and `kwWanted` (`planWantsMotion(rawPlan) && live.onScreen`, deliberately outside the `animatedFoil` gate so stilling foils never stills keyword marks). The face's one ranked claim (`hovered` first, then rarity, newest) now covers keyword loops too, and the rendered plan is gated on `faceMotion.moving`: a slot-less face maps every `on` to `off`. `data-art-motion`, `fxAttributesOf`, and `KeywordFx` take the gated plan; Armor/Divine Shield have `motion: null` so gating is a no-op for them.
- [keywordVisuals.ts](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3607/apps/web/src/cards/keywordVisuals.ts): added `planWantsMotion` (true when the plan loops under the per-unit rules: `AMBIENT_MAX`, `canAct` for Charge/Rush) plus an R3607000 header note. Nothing else in the planner changed.
- [R3607000.md](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3607/spec/rulings/R3607000.md) and [3607.md](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3607/spec/pending/3607.md): the ruling (option (a), hovered face keeps its loops at `SHED_FACES` per R3351000, presentation-only per rule 7, rejects a separate `KEYWORD_LOOPS_ANIMATED_MAX` budget) and its §11 paragraph.
- [keywordLoops.test.tsx](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3607/apps/web/src/cards/keywordLoops.test.tsx): 7 proving tests, every title containing `R3607000`.

Off-screen, hidden tab, shed at `SHED_FACES`, and all reduced-motion settings still every loop through the existing `useArtMotion`/`useMotionSlot` machinery — no new allocator, constant, or CSS change.

- `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/cards/keywordLoops.test.tsx` → 7/7 pass (after `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh`, which the web tests require).

- Neighbors: `keywordVisuals.test.tsx` (unedited, green — a single face always holds a slot), `motionSlots.test.ts`, `artLive.test.tsx`, `fullArtBoard.test.tsx`, `qa-v020.test.tsx` → 177/177 pass.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `cargo fmt --check`, `eslint` on the touched files, and `cargo jackioh spec check` (`1901 rulings, 4927 proofs … ok`) all pass.

- Chose option (a) (face's existing slot) over (b) (separate `KEYWORD_LOOPS_ANIMATED_MAX` budget), per the plan: reuses the ranked, shed-aware, visibility-aware claim with no new constant or allocator. Consequence, accepted: keyword claims now compete with foil/art claims in the one 6-slot budget.

# #3607: Patch (part 3 of 6): keyword loops on a budget: a minion's keyword treatments move only while it holds a motion slot
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

Part of #3604. Most keyword treatments loop forever on every board minion that has the keyword. `cards/keywordVisuals.ts` gives `chain-sway`, `ward-shimmer`, `venom-drip`, `crack-flicker`, `vein-pulse`, `echo-rise`, `rune-glow`, `glint-twinkle`, `shockwave` and the rest `motion: { when: "always" }`, and `keywords.css` runs each `.kw-anim` `infinite` while `data-kw-motion="on"` (R438). These loops ignore the motion-slot budget that caps moving faces at `COSMETIC_FOIL_ANIMATED_MAX` (6) (`cards/motionSlots.ts`, R3340000, R1295000). They don't pause off screen and the shed ladder never touches them (`fx/shed.ts`). A full board with two or three looping keywords a minion runs several dozen infinite animations, most of them repainting SVG.

Put the keyword loops on a budget. Pick the simplest of:

- (a) a minion's looping treatments move only while its face holds a motion slot, and otherwise show their still frame. The face already claims a slot through `motionSlots.ts`, and the hovered face ranks first.
- (b) a budget of their own, a named constant such as `KEYWORD_LOOPS_ANIMATED_MAX`, ranked as the motion slots are: hovered first, then newest.

Either way they stop while off screen (the `IntersectionObserver` `artLive.ts` already has) and at `SHED_FACES` and deeper. `when: "canAct"` treatments (Charge, Rush) keep showing that the minion can act, since that tells the player something. Keep them looping only while it can act, still under the budget, or as a still mark if the budget is full. The still frame of every treatment must still read as its keyword. Record the decision as a ruling from this issue's block (CLAUDE.md rule 3).

### Acceptance

- On a board of 14 minions each with three looping keywords, at most the budget's number of minions have `data-kw-motion="on"`, and the hovered minion is always one of them (component test).
- A face scrolled off screen, a hidden page, and the shed ladder at `SHED_FACES` each set every keyword loop still.
- Reduced motion still runs none, as today.
- Each keyword's treatment still renders its still frame with its `data-keyword-fx` attributes, so the existing keyword tests and e2e selectors pass unchanged.
- The proving tests are named after the new ruling, and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.

### Blocked by, part of

Part of #3604
